help.title: Help Center
help.subtitle: FAQ and usage guides
help.regVerifyQ: Why do I need to verify my email?
help.regVerifyA: Email verification protects your account and ensures you receive important notifications (like password resets). After registering, check your email and click the verification link.
help.regResendQ: What if I didn't receive the verification email?
help.regResendA: Check your spam folder. If you still can't find it, you can resend the verification email from the verification page or click resend in Settings.
help.pubHowA: After logging in, go to Creator Studio, select "Publish Original" or "Publish Fanwork", choose a content type, fill in the title, body, and attachments, then submit. Published content goes through a review process.
help.pubReviewQ: Why does published content need review?
help.pubReviewA: All published content goes through content safety review to ensure compliance. Content will be publicly visible after review approval.
help.dlHowQ: How do I download content attachments?
help.dlHowA: On the content detail page, click the download button in the attachments section. Some content may require you to be logged in to download.
help.favHowA: Click the favorite button on the content detail page. You can view all your favorites in "My Favorites" in Creator Studio.
help.reportHowQ: How do I report violating content?
help.reportHowA: Click the report button on the content detail page or comment area, select a reason and submit. If the report is verified as valid, you will earn reputation points.
help.repWhatA: Reputation measures the quality of your community behavior. The initial value is 10. Publishing quality content and comments earns points, while malicious behavior deducts points. Below 3 points, some features are restricted.
help.repRestoreQ: How do I restore low reputation?
help.repRestoreA: When your reputation drops below 3, you can restore points by completing rehabilitation courses. Each course can only be completed once. You can also gradually restore reputation by publishing quality content.
help.agentWhatQ: What can the AI assistant do?
help.agentWhatA: The AI assistant can help you search content, generate usage guides, assist with uploads, and perform compliance checks. You can find AI assistant entries on content detail and publishing pages.
help.clientWhatA: The OmniCraft client is a desktop application that supports one-click mod deployment to game directories and more. The client has not been released yet — stay tuned.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Learn how we collect, use, and protect your personal information
privacy.dataProcessingContent: We collect information you provide (such as registration email and username) and information generated automatically when using the service (such as browsing history and operation logs). All data processing is based on legitimate purposes and does not exceed what is necessary.
privacy.cookiesContent: We use HttpOnly cookies to store session refresh tokens and CSRF cookies to prevent cross-site request forgery. These cookies are essential for the service to function properly and are not used for ad tracking.
privacy.uploadsContent: Your uploaded content files are stored on Alibaba Cloud OSS, isolated by user ID directories. Uploaded files go through content safety review. After account deletion, associated files are cleaned up through lifecycle rules.
privacy.logsContent: Server logs record request method, path, status code, response time, and client IP for troubleshooting and security auditing. Logs do not contain passwords, tokens, or API keys.
privacy.feedbackDiagnosticsContent: When submitting feedback, you may optionally include diagnostic information (app version, platform, current route, error code). Diagnostics never include tokens, cookies, local paths, or request headers.
privacy.deletionContent: You can request account deletion. After deletion, your personal information will be anonymized and published content will remain with the author shown as "Deleted User". This action is irreversible.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: By using OmniCraft, you agree to the following terms
terms.acceptanceContent: By registering for or using OmniCraft services, you agree to comply with these Terms of Service. If you do not agree with any part of these terms, please stop using the service.
terms.accountResponsibilityContent: You are responsible for your account activity. Please keep your password secure and do not lend your account to others. If you discover unauthorized use, notify us immediately.
terms.contentRulesContent: Content you publish must comply with laws and community guidelines. Content involving illegal activities, plagiarism, or malicious attacks is prohibited. Violating content will be removed and the publisher will face reputation penalties.
terms.communityGuidelinesContent: Please respect other users and communicate rationally. Malicious reporting, malicious comments, and spamming will be penalized. Features are restricted when reputation drops below 3.
terms.ipRightsContent: You retain intellectual property rights to your original content. By publishing content, you grant the platform a license to display and distribute it. Fanwork should respect the original creator's intellectual property.
terms.liabilityContent: The platform provides the service "as is" without guarantee of uninterrupted operation. To the extent permitted by law, the platform is not liable for any direct or indirect losses arising from the use of the service.
terms.changesContent: We may update these terms from time to time. Significant changes will be communicated through in-app notifications or email. Continued use of the service indicates acceptance of the updated terms.
